noncomputable def VTask.prev {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ l) : α := 
  let n := l.length
  let i := l.find (· = x)
  l.get ⟨(i + n - 1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (by simp)⟩
